summary.label:
This application aims to help parents in their feeding journey by educating and guiding them on how to start solids with their babies through the baby-led weaning (BLW) approach.


In this app you will find:
• A detailed guide for each age with how to start and navigate  Baby-led Weaning from 6 to 24 months of age
• A Food Library with photos, videos, and tips on how to cut and prepare food safely for your baby
• 400+ easy recipes suitable for 6 months+ and perfect for the whole family
• Checklist with baby's first foods 
• Daily updates


Recipes: delicious, quick, and easy to make
• 400+ recipes made by nutritionists and board certified dietitians
• 300+ Vegetarian and 200+ vegan recipes
• Use our filters to find exactly what you’re looking for
• Delicious meals for babies, children, and adults!
• Search for specific ingredients, save your favorites, and take notes!
• The best cookbook ever!
